mx.teacher_note: Fat is absent because there is no blue-black colour.

intelligence.enrichment: If oil or butter is present in a food item, it leaves an oily patch on paper; the oily patch indicates the presence of fat. oil or butter in food -> oily patch on paper -> evidence of fat The learner correctly applies this rule: If oil or butter is present in a food item, it leaves an oily patch on paper; the oily patch indicates the presence of fat. Any mark on paper is just water or dirt and cannot identify a food component.
